```{r}
#| message: false
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap) 
library(here) # file path management
library(stars)
library(gt)
library(testthat)
```

## Background


## Data
VIIRS data is distributed through NASA’s [Level-1 and Atmospheric Archive & Distribution System Distributed Active Archive Center (LAADS DAAC)](https://ladsweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/).

We used [Geofabrik’s download sites](https://download.geofabrik.de/) to retrieve a shapefile of all highways in Texas and prepared a Geopackage (.gpkg file) containing just the subset of roads that intersect the Houston metropolitan area.

We can also obtain building data from OpenStreetMap. We again downloaded from Geofabrick and prepared a GeoPackage containing only houses in the Houston metropolitan area.


```{r}
# Read VIIRS tiles for February 7, 2021
pre_5 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
)

pre_6 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")
)

# Read VIIRS tiles for February 16, 2021
post_5 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
)

post_6 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")
)

pre <- st_mosaic(pre_5, pre_6)
post <- st_mosaic(post_5, post_6)

# Read motorway roads only
roads <- read_sf(
  here::here("data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
)

# Read likely residential buildings only
houses <- read_sf(
  here::here("data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
         WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
         OR type IN ('residential','apartments','house','static_caravan','detached')"
)
```

```{r}
if (!identical(dim(pre), dim(post)) | st_crs(pre) != st_crs(post)) {
  stop("Pre and post rasters do not align")
} else {
  print("rasters align")
}
```

```{r}
# Creating bounding box to Houston coordinates
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = -96.5,
    ymin = 29,
    xmax = -94.5,
    ymax = 30.5
  ),
  crs = st_crs(pre)
)
```

```{r}
# Cropping to Houston bounding box
pre_houston  <- st_crop(pre, houston_bbox)
post_houston <- st_crop(post, houston_bbox)

# Combining rasters and labeling each by date
pre_post_storms <- c(pre_houston, post_houston)
names(pre_post_storms) <- c("Before: Feb 7, 2021", "After: Feb 16, 2021")
```

```{r}
pre_values <- as.vector(pre_houston[[1]])
boxplot(pre_values, main = "Pre-storm night light values", 
     ylab = "Intensity (nW cm-2 sr-1)")
```


```{r}
post_values <- as.vector(post_houston[[1]])
boxplot(post_values,main = "Post-storm night light values", 
     ylab = "Intensity (nW cm-2 sr-1)")
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
# Breaks for skewed nighttime light values
light_breaks <- c(0, 10, 50, 200, 1000, Inf)

# Plot side by side with one shared legend
tm_shape(pre_post_storms) +
  tm_raster(
    col = c(
      "Before: Feb 7, 2021",
      "After: Feb 16, 2021"
    ),
    col.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = light_breaks,
      values = "viridis"
    ),
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      "Night light intensity (nW cm-2 sr-1)",
      orientation = "landscape",
      position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom")
    ),
    col.free = FALSE
  ) +
  tm_facets_wrap(ncol = 2) +
  tm_scalebar(
    position = c("left", "bottom"),
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.alpha = 0.7,
    text.size = 0.7
  ) +
  tm_compass(
    position = c("right", "top"),
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.alpha = 0.7
  )+
  tm_title("Nighttime Lights Before and After February 2021 Great Texas Freeze")
```

```{r}
blackout_mask <- pre - post
```


```{r}
# Set all cells with values less than 200 to NA
blackout_mask[blackout_mask<200] <- NA
```

```{r}
# Vectorizing 
blackout_sf <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask) |>
  st_make_valid()
```



```{r}
blackout_houston <- st_crop(
  blackout_sf,
  houston_bbox
)

if(all(st_bbox(blackout_sf)==st_bbox(blackout_houston))){
  warning("extents unchanged")
}else{
  print("extent reduced")

  }
```


```{r}
blackout_houston <-st_transform(blackout_houston, st_crs("EPSG:3083"))

test_that("blackout_houston is in EPSG:3083", {
  expect_equal(st_crs(blackout_houston)$epsg, 3083)
})
```

```{r}
# Transform roads to match blackout CRS
roads <- st_transform(
  roads,
  st_crs(blackout_houston)
)

# Test CRS match
test_that("roads crs matches blackout crs", {
  expect_equal(st_crs(roads), st_crs(blackout_houston))
})

```

```{r}
road_buffer <- st_buffer(roads, dist = 200)
```


```{r}
road_union <- st_union(road_buffer)
```


```{r}
#| warning: false
blackout_houston_nr <- st_difference(
  blackout_houston,
  road_union
)
```


```{r}
# Verifying removing highway reduced blackout area
if (sum(st_area(blackout_houston_nr)) >= sum(st_area(blackout_houston))) {
  warning("area was not reduced")
} else {
  print("highway removal reduced area")
}
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
houses_houston <- st_crop(
  houses,
  houston_bbox
)
```

```{r}
# verify that cropping changed the extent
if (all(st_bbox(houses) == st_bbox(houses_houston))) {
  warning("extents unchanged")
} else {
  print("extent reduced")
}
```

```{r}
# Transform houses to match blackout CRS
houses <- st_transform(
  houses,
  st_crs(blackout_houston)
)

# Verifying CRS match
if (st_crs(houses) != st_crs(blackout_houston_nr)) {
  stop("CRS does not match")
} else {
  print("it's a match!")
}
```


```{r}
# st_filter with st_intersects (the default predicate)
houses_filter <- st_filter(houses, blackout_houston_nr)
```


```{r}
houses_blackouts <-
  st_geometry(houses_filter)
```


```{r}
bo_summ <- houses_filter |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    n_blackout = n()
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_houston = nrow(houses_houston),
    n_no_blackout = n_houston - n_blackout,
    pcnt_house = (n_blackout / n_houston) * 100
  ) |>
  select(
    n_blackout,
    n_no_blackout,
    n_houston,
    pcnt_house
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("Houston Homes Affected by Blackout")
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    n_houston = "Total Homes",
    n_blackout = "Homes in Blackout Areas",
    n_no_blackout = "Homes Not in Blackout Areas",
    pcnt_house = "Percent Affected"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(n_houston, n_blackout, n_no_blackout),
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = pcnt_house,
    decimals = 2,
    pattern = "{x}%"
  )

bo_summ
```


```{r}
bo_houston <-
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap", zoom = 9, alpha = 0.9) +
  tm_shape(blackout_houston_nr) +
  tm_polygons()

hb_houston <-
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap", zoom = 9, alpha = 0.9) +
  tm_shape(houses_blackouts) +
  tm_polygons()
tmap_arrange(bo_houston, hb_houston, nrow = 1)
```
